title: Tanvi Sharma Wins First BWF World Tour Title, Youngest Ever Champion
indian_angle: This marks a significant milestone for Indian badminton as a young talent secures a major international title.
summary: Teenager Tanvi Sharma clinched her maiden BWF World Tour title in Chinese Taipei, becoming the youngest winner in the tournament's history after overcoming previous final losses.

title: BAI Releases Player Eligibility for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: Indian junior players and their coaches need to adhere to these updated guidelines for selection to represent India at the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has issued new guidelines regarding player eligibility for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026 to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Haryana U-19 Tournament Postponed, Bhubaneswar Now World Junior Selection Event
indian_angle: This change directly impacts Indian junior players aiming for the World Junior Championships, as the Bhubaneswar event is now the sole selection tournament.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, with the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament now declared as the official selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will change the dynamics of domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues and Tournaments
indian_angle: Indian players and fans are advised to be cautious of unauthorized leagues and tournaments that are not sanctioned by the national body.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released an advisory warning players and stakeholders about participating in or promoting unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships.

title: India Invites EOI for Hosting BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: This Expression of Interest indicates India's ambition to host a major international badminton event, which would be a huge boost for the sport domestically.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has invited Expressions of Interest (EOI) for organizing the BWF World Championships 2026, signaling India's potential to host the prestigious global event.
